result.summary: The page appears to be a food delivery app home screen. Overall layout and content are well-structured. One minor issue was identified regarding a potentially confusing discount badge.

issues.description: The pizza card at the bottom displays a '-0%' badge, which is visually confusing as it implies a discount but the value is zero.
issues.suggestion: Remove the '-0%' badge if no actual discount is applied, or update it to reflect a meaningful promotion.
